flags.message: The manifest marks the 134-page application PDF truncated. Provisioned text includes the application but stops during appendix page 18a, omitting the complete district-court reasoning and the later injunction-pending-appeal and Ninth Circuit orders at appendix pages 63a–78a. No respondent brief was provisioned. Forecast relies on the available district-court introduction and explicitly attributed applicant summaries, not independently read appellate reasoning. Consider preserving the lower-court orders separately when the combined application appendix exceeds the text cap.
